trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The text is the point of the iceberg.
trap.right: The text is the tip of the iceberg.
trap.why: Em português “ponta do iceberg” leva a point; em inglês a expressão fixa é tip.

fix.wrong: It is the point of the iceberg.
fix.right: It is the tip of the iceberg.
Months of work were behind the scenes.

rewrite.answer: The text is the tip of the iceberg.

rewrite.prompt: Negativo: “It is the tip of the iceberg.”
rewrite.answer: It is not the tip of the iceberg.
